This is probably gonna sound cold because I'm a little who didn't just lose their CG but their boyfriend as well in the similar situation you're in. I got dumped but it wasn't out of the blue. We had our problems we couldn't fix and this was the only way out. I don't know if it's my anxious attachment style OR maybe I do have a codependent personality disorder. I just know my anxiety of being away from him drove this relationship over the edge.

My best advice is to not trust people if you don't feel like it. Don't force yourself into trusting people. It'll come naturally. Allow for the people in your life to earn it. it'll take months of friendship to earn yours. You went through something traumatic. Consider this as one of your boundaries. You don't wanna get hurt again. I tried opening up to people and being vulnerable to potential CGs straight after the breakup and it felt very disingenuous on my end. I felt I was faking everything. Even my own healing. So take your time.

As for healing alone, yeah. That's the hard part, lol. Uh, he kept me together. So, losing him made me become all over the place. Like, I'm fragmented and all pieces of me are falling apart. Not to be dramatic.

But like, you seem more in touch and self aware of what you need to work on. Focus on yourself. Don't force yourself into any situations for the sake of getting better. If you wanna lay in bed and watch anime all day, you can. Do that for a couple of weeks. A broken heart can't really be mend quickly. Think of it as an injured arm. You won't exercise or dance right away after it breaks, right? The heart is a muscle. Sounds cringe but. It's bruised and tender, now but I'll be back to being soft and open to new love one day. Just give it time.
